listing.name: My Little Pony
listing.summary: Adds My Little Pony themed content to Starfarer, including ships and lore options, currently under construction.
listing.aiSummary: Adds My Little Pony themed content to Starfarer, including ships and lore options, currently under construction.

description:
So it's finally happening. Be it your worst fear or your dream of a pony mod is coming to Starfarer come true.

The main people working on this mod will be evildog (spriting), SonicRaptor (spriting? and coding for ships), and myself (whatever else needs doing I guess).

But we are going to need a lot of input from My Little Pony - Friendship is Magic fans as to the direction this mod will take.

What do you people want to see in a Pony mod lore wise?

Do you want actual ponies or humans that take on the pony names and such or do you want Anthropomorphic ponies? (a cross between pony and human)As for the setting, do you want science-fiction and actual spaceships like those of Starfarer or do you want to see fantasy and magical ships like those of Spelljammer?We also need to think about the factions, do you want to see pony against pony ala Lunar Republic vs Solar Empire or do you want to see pony vs others for example Equestria vs Griffons or perhaps just a stand alone pony faction?

All input is welcome.

Lore donations are welcome.

Portrait and ship donations are welcome.

If you have good art sources you want to see used (pictures from pony booru for example) then provide us with a link please.

Test Versions of the Mod:

These are not perfect and some might crash your game, try at your own risk.
